The red is trivial and young. NEAR -3.8% at five days held, LINK -1.7% at thirteen, ADA -2.1% at seven. Nothing here is a sell. But a laggard is not a broken thesis, and we do not sell winners or cut two-week-old positions over sub-4% drawdowns.

No orders. Buying power is $7.14 and a $100 ZEC buy preview came back rejected by Robinhood for insufficient crypto buying power - a validated hard stop, not a judgment call. The seven-lens screen is academic when every tier ($200 conviction, $100-150 secondary) is unreachable. Until funds land, this is a watch-only feed: we can score setups but we cannot take them. That is the single most actionable line in today's scan.
